Compound Bow Women was a nail-biter from start to finish. Camila Duarte and Valentina Ortiz finished dead level on 318 points, with Duarte taking the top spot on the strength of 14 tens to Ortiz's 11, while Ortiz answered with 5 Xs. Sofía Giménez claimed third on 309 and hit 6 Xs, the most of any archer in the competition. Martina López rounded out the category with 280.

The recurve lines delivered tension too. Nicolás Vera led Recurve Bow Men with 299 points, ahead of Gabriel Ramírez (294) and Joaquín Martínez (289), with Andrés Cabrera on 266. In Recurve Bow Women, Lucía Fernández and Isabella Romero both posted 297, and Fernández edged to the front with 5 tens and 4 Xs. Paula Sanabria (283) and Elena Torres (257) completed a thrilling field. Congratulations to every archer!
